newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Basis offers flat-up on supply.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Basis offers flat-up on supply.

text.p: Basis offers in cash soymeal markets were steady to higher Monday as very tight supplies of soymeal continued to push cash markets up, brokers said.
"Prices continue to escalate in both the domestic and export market," said one river dealer.

Some Midwestern suppliers were said to be completely out of soymeal until the beginning of December, and only those end-users who are scrambling to cover needs were buyers in domestic spot markets, brokers said.
"Only the people who have to have it (soymeal) are the ones paying up for it," one Tennessee broker said.
Dealers expect the U.S. cash market to stay relatively firm until supplies of soymeal from South America begin to hit the market in February or March.
"The whole story is exports," one Minnesota broker said. "And it (brisk export business) should continue through December."
